title: Winspace G3 Gravel Pro Di2 complete bike
notes: Exact official complete-bike page markets the build as GRX RX825 Di2 1x12, while its itemized BOM identifies ST-RX825 controls, an RD-RX827 rear derailleur, 42T crank and 10-51T cassette. It also supports 700x40C fitted tires, 700x50C maximum clearance, approximately 8,750 g in size M without pedals, and a US$4,099 global-store price. It mentions a China warehouse route but does not expose a current mainland CNY checkout or exact domestic handling.
